definitions.explanation: A person's educational and work history. Used for resumes and formal records.
A chronological record of events, actions, or changes. Common in computing for browser history, transaction logs, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{履歴|りれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Write your educational and work history in your resume.

⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧{履歴|りれき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧{履歴|りれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧な⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: When I checked the transaction history, I found unauthorized access.

notes:
{履歴|りれき} refers to historical records, whether personal or digital.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ (resume, CV)
- ⟦{閲覧|えつらん}→閲覧：17691_etsuran⟧{履歴|りれき} (browsing history)
- ⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧{履歴|りれき} (search history)
- ⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧{履歴|りれき} (update history)
- ⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧{履歴|りれき} (transaction history)

USAGE NOTE: In computing contexts, {履歴|りれき} is the standard term for "history" (browser history, command history, etc.).
